sendMessage.noTemplateNotice: No template needed — sends directly within the 24hr session window.

Hello {{example}}! 👋

Welcome to our service. How can I help you today?

mediaUrlHint.prefix: Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL. Use

variableMappingsHint.suffix: used above to system or custom fields with fallback defaults.

sendTemplate.noResults: No templates found. Type name manually below.

variableMappingsHint.suffix: used in body params, header URL, or button URL suffix to user or custom fields with fallback defaults.

sendInteractive.sessionNotice: Requires 24hr session window. Configure a fallback template below.

condition.hint: Each branch creates an outgoing edge. Connect them to the next nodes on the canvas.
condition.importButton_one: Import {{count}} option from connected Interactive node
condition.importButton_other: Import {{count}} options from connected Interactive node

workflow.contextHint: The workflow will receive phone, instituteId, userId, and messageText as context.

aiCredits.outOfCreditsBody: This step will not call the model — conversations that reach it are handed to a human in the WhatsApp Inbox until the institute tops up.

aiResponse.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a helpful assistant for {{example}}. Answer questions about courses and enrollment...
aiResponse.fallbackMessagePlaceholder: Let me connect you with a human agent.
aiResponse.escalateCheckboxLabel: Hand over to an admin instead of guessing
aiResponse.handoverMessagePlaceholder: I don't have that information with me right now. Let me check with our team and get back to you shortly.

escalationNotice.prefix: When the answer isn't in the AI's context it sends this message instead of inventing one. The conversation is then marked
escalationNotice.middle: in the WhatsApp Inbox and the people listed under
escalationNotice.suffix: are told a learner is waiting, by email and/or WhatsApp. Replying from the Inbox clears it.

aiResponse.interactiveCheckboxLabel: Allow AI to send reply buttons and list menus
aiResponse.interactiveNotice: The AI can now include reply buttons (max 3) or list menus when presenting choices. Falls back to plain text if the format is invalid or 24hr session expired.

crmLeadCheck.hint: Looks this WhatsApp number up across your CRM. A new number is added to the “WhatsApp Leads” list straight away. A known lead is never duplicated — the contact is recorded on their existing lead.
crmLeadCheck.connectBothNotice: An output that isn't connected ends the flow for that kind of lead. Drag from the matching dot at the bottom of the node to connect it.
crmLeadCheck.existingMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Welcome back! Our team will get in touch with you shortly.
crmLeadCheck.notifyTeamHint: Marks the chat as waiting for a reply in the WhatsApp Inbox and notifies the people in this flow's Settings.

askField.hint: Asks one question, waits for the reply, checks it fits the field and saves it on the lead.
askField.noCustomFields: No custom fields yet — add them in Settings → Custom Fields.
askField.missingFieldNotice: This field no longer exists in your custom fields. Choose another one.
askField.noChoicesNotice: This field has no choices set up yet. Add them in Settings → Custom Fields.
askField.choicesChangedNotice: This field's choices have changed since it was picked.
askField.retryMessagePlaceholder: Sorry, that doesn't look right. Please try again.
askField.retryMessageHint: Sent when the reply doesn't fit the field — e.g. not a valid email, or not one of the choices.
askField.noSaveStepNotice: Add a “Save Lead to CRM” step after your questions to set the lead status and run your lead workflows.

preview.modeList: Sent as a list they open with the button.
preview.modeNumbered: More than 10 choices — sent as a numbered list; they reply with the number.
preview.modeMultiSelect: Multi-select — sent as a numbered list; they can reply with several numbers.
preview.longChoiceNotice: Some choices are longer than WhatsApp allows here ({{max}} characters) and may be cut short.

saveToCrm.hint: Saves every answer collected in this flow on the lead — creating the lead if it doesn't exist yet — and runs your lead-submission workflows.
saveToCrm.missingStatusNotice: This status no longer exists. Choose another, or “Don't change”.
saveToCrm.successMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Thanks! Our team will contact you soon.
saveToCrm.fireWorkflowsHint: Runs this institute's "lead submitted" workflows (e.g. confirmation messages, admin alerts) for a new lead once the answers are saved. Turn off if those workflows would send the person a second welcome message. Never runs for a lead that already existed.
